generationBriefTemplate.prompt: Professional B2B tech campaign hero. Navy background (#070A40). Clean geometric diagram showing three connected nodes: 'Registry (YAML)' → 'Generator (Jinja2)' → 'Orchestrator (MessageBus)'. Nodes in navy with cyan borders, connections in cyan. Subtle grid pattern. LightSpeed logo top-left. Headline '{HEADLINE}' in cyan. Red CTA button '{CTA}'. Corporate, trustworthy, engineering-led aesthetic. No people, no stock photos.

qaGates: Logo is official asset from brand/logos/, clear space respected
Brand palette only: navy #070A40, red #E63946, cyan #00BFFF, lightGrey #F2F2F2, white #FFFFFF
Red reserved for CTA button only
Text within safe zones (≥15% inset), no clipping/overflow
Proof is real, traceable fact (37 agents, 3 offers, 1 CLI from company-registry.yaml)
Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for all copy (cyan on navy, white on navy, white on red)
No generic stock-photo AI vibe; brand-consistent graphics only
